articles.title: Eternal among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
articles.excerpt:
On July 27, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.

Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward price momentum.
